title: New benzotriazole–sulfonate coupling reagents and applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,24659-24666
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA03443H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sayanta Roy, Bhubaneswar Mandal
New benzotriazole–sulfonate reagents enable sustainable and efficient amidation, esterification, and the synthesis of nitriles from aldoximes and ketones from carboxylic acids. These reagents will find wider applications in other organic syntheses.
